rgb.criterion: highest holdout accuracy, tie lower path

gt.criterion: highest holdout accuracy, tie lower path

depth_occupancy.definition: navmesh is_navigable(point) proxy on a deterministic 2,048-point sample per context

high_occlusion.definition: strict lower tertile of current-slot 17-joint Frame0 visibility

protocol.action_set: Stage-A legal candidate-only; current/stay excluded for selectors

map_cache_train.robust_definition: 17 current H36M17 joints x +/-x,+/-y,+/-z at eps 0.05/0.10/0.20m
map_cache_train.clearance_definition: four endpoint cone rays around eight representative current joints

map_cache_moving_val.robust_definition: 17 current H36M17 joints x +/-x,+/-y,+/-z at eps 0.05/0.10/0.20m
map_cache_moving_val.clearance_definition: four endpoint cone rays around eight representative current joints

protocol.lambda_selection: Policy Train record holdout only; Moving Val not used
